local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

local function notify(title, message, duration)
	local details = {
		Title = title,
		Text = message,
		Duration = duration,
		Button1 = "OK",
	}

	for _ = 1, 8 do
		if pcall(StarterGui.SetCore, StarterGui, "SendNotification", details) then
			return
		end
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
	warn(title .. ": " .. message)
end

local environmentGetter = getgenv
local executorDebug = debug
local missing = {}

if type(environmentGetter) ~= "function" then
	table.insert(missing, "getgenv")
end
for _, name in { "getupvalues", "getupvalue", "setupvalue" } do
	if type(executorDebug) ~= "table" or type(executorDebug[name]) ~= "function" then
		table.insert(missing, "debug." .. name)
	end
end

if #missing > 0 then
	notify("Executor APIs Missing", "Required: " .. table.concat(missing, ", "), 20)
	return
end

local environmentOk, environment = pcall(function()
	return environmentGetter()
end)
if not environmentOk then
	notify("Executor APIs Missing", "getgenv() failed: " .. tostring(environment), 20)
	return
end
if type(environment) ~= "table" then
	notify("Executor APIs Missing", "getgenv() did not return a table.", 20)
	return
end

local upvalues = executorDebug.getupvalues
local getupvalue = executorDebug.getupvalue
local setupvalue = executorDebug.setupvalue

local previous = environment.__aimSession
if previous then
	assert(type(previous.unload) == "function", "Existing shooting hook cannot be unloaded")
	local success, reason = pcall(previous.unload, true)
	assert(success and environment.__aimSession ~= previous,
		"Could not unload the existing shooting hook: " .. tostring(reason))
end

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local ClientShootable = require(ReplicatedStorage.Client.CombatController.ClientComponent.ClientShootableComponent)
local CombatController = require(ReplicatedStorage.Client.CombatController)
local CommonWeapon = require(ReplicatedStorage.Common.CombatService.CommonWeapon)
local Entities = require(ReplicatedStorage.Remote.EntityService)
local HumanoidEntity = require(ReplicatedStorage.Remote.EntityService.Entity.HumanoidEntity)
local Collision = require(ReplicatedStorage.Constant).Collision
local Combat = require(ReplicatedStorage.Config.Config).Combat

local originalShoot = ClientShootable.Shoot
local localShoot = ClientShootable.LocalShoot
assert(type(originalShoot) == "function" and type(localShoot) == "function",
	"The game's shooting functions are unavailable")

local originIndex, originalOrigin
for index, value in upvalues(originalShoot) do
	if type(value) == "function" then
		assert(originIndex == nil, "The weapon has more than one origin function")
		originIndex, originalOrigin = index, value
	end
end
assert(originIndex ~= nil, "The weapon's origin function was not found")

local localOriginMatches = 0
for _, value in upvalues(localShoot) do
	if value == originalOrigin then
		localOriginMatches += 1
	end
end
assert(localOriginMatches == 1, "LocalShoot uses a different combat origin")

local CONE_DOT = math.cos(math.rad(15))
local FIRE_INPUT = "trigger"
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.RespectCanCollide = false

local state = {
	active = true,
	enabled = true,
	triggerbot = false,
	heldWeapon = nil,
	triggerConnection = nil,
	selectedEntity = nil,
	selectedAt = -math.huge,
	preparedShot = nil,
	connections = {},
	reportedSelectionError = false,
	menuKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift,
	aimKey = Enum.KeyCode.V,
	triggerKey = Enum.KeyCode.T,
	deviceLabel = "Mobile",
	uiVisible = true,
	lockMouse = true,
	uiSync = nil :: (() -> ())?,
	uiDestroy = nil :: (() -> ())?,
}

local HEAD_POINTS = {
	Vector3.new(0, 0, 0),
	Vector3.new(0, 0.36, 0),
	Vector3.new(-0.36, 0, 0),
	Vector3.new(0.36, 0, 0),
	Vector3.new(0, -0.36, 0),
	Vector3.new(-0.3, 0.3, 0),
	Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0),
	Vector3.new(-0.3, -0.3, 0),
	Vector3.new(0.3, -0.3, 0),
}

local BODY_PARTS = {
	Body = true, Torso = true, UpperTorso = true, LowerTorso = true,
	Arm = true, LeftArm = true, RightArm = true,
	LeftUpperArm = true, LeftLowerArm = true, LeftHand = true,
	RightUpperArm = true, RightLowerArm = true, RightHand = true,
	LeftLeg = true, RightLeg = true,
	LeftUpperLeg = true, LeftLowerLeg = true, LeftFoot = true,
	RightUpperLeg = true, RightLowerLeg = true, RightFoot = true,
}

local function inspectPoint(model, part, point, origin, view, headOnly)
	local offset = point - origin
	local distance = offset.Magnitude
	if distance <= 0.01 or distance > Combat.BulletMaxDistance
		or view:Dot(offset.Unit) < CONE_DOT then
		return nil
	end

	local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin, offset, rayParams)
	if headOnly then
		if hit and hit.Instance == part then
			return point, distance, part
		end
	elseif not hit or hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(model) then
		return point, distance, part
	end
	return nil
end

local function visiblePoint(entity, origin, view)
	local model = entity:GetModel()
	if not model or not model:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
		return nil
	end

	local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head", true)
	if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
		local frame, size = head.CFrame, head.Size
		for _, sample in HEAD_POINTS do
			local point = frame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(
				sample.X * size.X, sample.Y * size.Y, sample.Z * size.Z
			))
			local aimPoint, distance, part = inspectPoint(model, head, point, origin, view, true)
			if aimPoint then
				return aimPoint, distance, part
			end
		end
	end

	local body = entity:GetBodyPart()
	local root = entity:GetRootPart()
	for _, part in { body, root } do
		if part and part ~= head and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			local aimPoint, distance, hitPart = inspectPoint(model, part, part.Position, origin, view, false)
			if aimPoint then
				return aimPoint, distance, hitPart
			end
		end
	end

	for _, part in model:GetDescendants() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and BODY_PARTS[part.Name] and part ~= body and part ~= root then
			local aimPoint, distance, hitPart = inspectPoint(model, part, part.Position, origin, view, false)
			if aimPoint then
				return aimPoint, distance, hitPart
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function acquireTarget(origin, view)
	local self = Entities.GetLocalEntity()
	if not self or not self:IsAlive() then
		return nil
	end
	local group = self:GetCollision(Collision.Attack)
	if type(group) ~= "string" then
		return nil
	end

	rayParams.CollisionGroup = group
	local character = self:GetWorkspaceRoot()
	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = character and { character } or {}

	local function isHostile(entity)
		return entity ~= self and HumanoidEntity:is(entity)
			and entity:IsAlive() and not self:IsFriendly(entity)
	end

	if state.selectedEntity and os.clock() - state.selectedAt <= 0.22
		and isHostile(state.selectedEntity) then
		local point, distance, part = visiblePoint(state.selectedEntity, origin, view)
		if point then
			return state.selectedEntity, point, distance, part
		end
	end

	local closestEntity, closestPoint, closestDistance, closestPart
	closestDistance = Combat.BulletMaxDistance
	for _, entity in Entities.Entity.GetAll() do
		if isHostile(entity) then
			local point, distance, part = visiblePoint(entity, origin, view)
			if point and distance < closestDistance then
				closestEntity, closestPoint, closestDistance, closestPart = entity, point, distance, part
			end
		end
	end
	return closestEntity, closestPoint, closestDistance, closestPart
end

local function reportSelectionError(reason)
	if not state.reportedSelectionError then
		state.reportedSelectionError = true
		warn("Target selection failed: " .. tostring(reason))
	end
end

local function redirectedOrigin(...)
	local origin, detectedAt, cameraData = originalOrigin(...)
	if not (state.active and state.enabled and typeof(origin) == "CFrame") then
		return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
	end

	if state.preparedShot == false then
		return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
	end

	local entity, point
	if state.preparedShot then
		entity, point = state.preparedShot.entity, state.preparedShot.point
	else
		local success, selected, selectedPoint = pcall(acquireTarget, origin.Position, origin.LookVector)
		if not success then
			reportSelectionError(selected)
			return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
		end
		entity, point = selected, selectedPoint
	end

	if not point then
		return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
	end
	local offset = point - origin.Position
	if offset.Magnitude <= 0.001 or origin.LookVector:Dot(offset.Unit) < CONE_DOT then
		return origin, detectedAt, cameraData
	end

	state.selectedEntity = entity
	state.selectedAt = os.clock()
	return CFrame.lookAt(origin.Position, point), detectedAt, cameraData
end

local function runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, prepared)
	state.preparedShot = prepared
	local success, result = pcall(originalShoot, component, start, direction, context)
	state.preparedShot = nil
	if not success then
		error(result, 0)
	end
	return result
end

local function shootWithTarget(component, start, direction, context)
	if not (state.active and state.enabled) then
		return originalShoot(component, start, direction, context)
	end

	local success, origin = pcall(originalOrigin)
	if not success or typeof(origin) ~= "CFrame" then
		return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, false)
	end

	local selected, entity, point, _, part = pcall(acquireTarget, origin.Position, origin.LookVector)
	if not selected then
		reportSelectionError(entity)
		return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, false)
	end
	if not entity or not point then
		return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, false)
	end

	local pivot = entity:GetPivot(true)
	local offset = point - origin.Position
	if not pivot or offset.Magnitude <= 0.001 or origin.LookVector:Dot(offset.Unit) < CONE_DOT then
		return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, context, false)
	end

	local shotContext = context or {}
	shotContext.Target = entity.Instance
	shotContext.TargetPos = pivot:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	shotContext.TargetHeadshot = part ~= nil and part.Name == "Head"
	return runOriginalShoot(component, start, direction, shotContext, { entity = entity, point = point })
end

local function releaseTrigger()
	local held = state.heldWeapon
	state.heldWeapon = nil
	if held then
		local shooter = held._Shootable
		if shooter and shooter.StopShootingTimer then
			local success, reason = pcall(shooter.StopShootingTimer, shooter, { Input = FIRE_INPUT })
			if not success then
				warn("Could not stop firing: " .. tostring(reason))
			end
		end
	end
end

local function hasTargetInCrosshair(entity, origin)
	local model = entity:GetModel()
	if not model then
		return false
	end
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(origin.Position, origin.LookVector * Combat.BulletMaxDistance, rayParams)
	return hit ~= nil and hit.Instance:IsDescendantOf(model)
end

local function checkTrigger()
	if not state.active or not state.triggerbot then
		releaseTrigger()
		return
	end

	if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() or UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
		releaseTrigger()
		return
	end

	local weapon = CombatController.GetWeapon()
	local shooter = weapon and weapon._Shootable
	if not (weapon and weapon.Activated and shooter and not shooter.Destroyed) then
		releaseTrigger()
		return
	end

	local origin = originalOrigin()
	if typeof(origin) ~= "CFrame" then
		releaseTrigger()
		return
	end

	local entity = acquireTarget(origin.Position, origin.LookVector)
	if not entity or (not state.enabled and not hasTargetInCrosshair(entity, origin)) then
		releaseTrigger()
		return
	end

	local automatic = shooter:IsFullAuto()
	if state.heldWeapon and (state.heldWeapon ~= weapon or not automatic) then
		releaseTrigger()
	end
	if automatic then
		if state.heldWeapon then
			return
		end
		if not (shooter:CanShoot() and shooter:CanShootNow()) then
			return
		end
		if weapon:CanAction(CommonWeapon.Action.Primary) then
			if CombatController.PrimaryAction.Begin(FIRE_INPUT) then
				state.heldWeapon = weapon
			end
		end
		return
	end

	if shooter:CanShoot() and shooter:CanShootNow() and weapon:CanAction(CommonWeapon.Action.Primary) then
		CombatController.PrimaryAction.Begin(FIRE_INPUT)
	end
end

local function runTrigger()
	local success, reason = pcall(checkTrigger)
	if not success then
		state.triggerbot = false
		local sync = state.uiSync
		if sync then
			sync()
		end
		if state.triggerConnection then
			state.triggerConnection:Disconnect()
			state.triggerConnection = nil
		end
		releaseTrigger()
		warn("Triggerbot stopped: " .. tostring(reason))
		notify("Triggerbot", "Stopped: " .. tostring(reason), 8)
	end
end

local function setTriggerbot(enabled)
	state.triggerbot = enabled
	if enabled then
		if not state.triggerConnection then
			state.triggerConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(runTrigger)
		end
	else
		if state.triggerConnection then
			state.triggerConnection:Disconnect()
			state.triggerConnection = nil
		end
		releaseTrigger()
	end
end

local deviceReport

local function restoreDeviceReport()
	local saved = deviceReport
	if not saved then
		return
	end
	deviceReport = nil
	if saved.connection then saved.connection:Disconnect() end

	local actualDevice = saved.input.Device
	if type(actualDevice) == "string" and actualDevice ~= state.deviceLabel then
		local ok, reason = pcall(function()
			saved.remote:FireServer(actualDevice)
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("Could not restore device report: " .. tostring(reason))
		end
	end
end

local function enableDeviceReport()
	if deviceReport then
		return
	end
	local input = require(ReplicatedStorage.Client.InputHelper)
	local devices = require(ReplicatedStorage.Constant).Device
	local remote = ReplicatedStorage.Remote.Any.Device
	local changed = input.Event and input.Event.DeviceChanged
	assert(changed and type(changed.Connect) == "function", "DeviceChanged signal is unavailable")
	assert(type(remote.FireServer) == "function", "Device reporting is unavailable")
	assert(type(devices[state.deviceLabel]) == "string", "Reported device is unavailable")

	local saved = {
		input = input, remote = remote, devices = devices,
		warned = false, report = function() end,
		connection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
	}
	local function report()
		if not state.active or deviceReport ~= saved then
			return
		end
		local ok, reason = pcall(function()
			remote:FireServer(devices[state.deviceLabel])
		end)
		if not ok and not saved.warned then
			saved.warned = true
			warn("Could not report device: " .. tostring(reason))
		end
	end
	saved.report = report
	saved.connection = changed:Connect(report)
	deviceReport = saved
	report()
end

local function buildPanel()
	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local playerGui = player and player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
	assert(playerGui, "PlayerGui is unavailable")

	local colour = {
		base = Color3.fromRGB(23, 27, 33),
		inner = Color3.fromRGB(31, 36, 44),
		raised = Color3.fromRGB(43, 50, 60),
		border = Color3.fromRGB(73, 82, 95),
		text = Color3.fromRGB(241, 244, 247),
		muted = Color3.fromRGB(153, 164, 177),
		accent = Color3.fromRGB(85, 207, 173),
		active = Color3.fromRGB(31, 78, 69),
		alert = Color3.fromRGB(226, 120, 115),
	}
	local images = {
		main = "rbxassetid://83752373575368",
		settings = "rbxassetid://106205298246017",
		minimise = "rbxassetid://95070996149109",
		power = "rbxassetid://89331085993646",
		check = "rbxassetid://86817768619372",
	}
	local controls = {}
	local bindings = {}
	local uiConnections = {}
	local activePress = nil
	local capturing = nil :: string?
	local dragging = nil
	local pointerStart = Vector2.zero
	local popupOpen = false
	local cursor = { bound = false, behavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default, iconVisible = true }
	local cursorStep = "ys.menu.cursor." .. tostring(player.UserId)

	local function connect(signal, callback)
		local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
		table.insert(uiConnections, connection)
		return connection
	end

	local function create(class, parent, values)
		local item = Instance.new(class)
		for key, value in values do
			item[key] = value
		end
		item.Parent = parent
		return item
	end

	local function round(parent, radius)
		create("UICorner", parent, { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) })
	end

	local function icon(parent, image, x, y, size, tint, z)
		return create("ImageLabel", parent, {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = image, ImageColor3 = tint or colour.muted,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
			ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ZIndex = z or 1,
		})
	end

	local function label(parent, content, x, y, width, height, size, tint, bold)
		return create("TextLabel", parent, {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = content, TextSize = size,
			Font = bold and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
			TextColor3 = tint or colour.text, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
			TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
		})
	end

	local screen = create("ScreenGui", playerGui, {
		Name = "YSHub", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = false,
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, DisplayOrder = 10000,
	})
	local uiRoot = gethui
	if type(uiRoot) == "function" then
		local ok, root = pcall(uiRoot)
		if ok and typeof(root) == "Instance" then
			pcall(function() screen.Parent = root end)
		end
	end
	local modal = create("TextButton", screen, {
		Name = "MouseInput", Text = "", BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		AutoButtonColor = false, Modal = true, Active = true, ZIndex = 0,
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Visible = false,
	})
	local function releaseMouse()
		modal.Visible = false
		if not cursor.bound then return end
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(cursorStep)
		cursor.bound = false
		-- The Roblox pause menu owns the cursor while it is open.
		if not GuiService.MenuIsOpen then
			if UserInputService.MouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.Default then
				UserInputService.MouseBehavior = cursor.behavior
			end
			UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = cursor.iconVisible
		end
		cursor.behavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		cursor.iconVisible = true
	end
	local function updateMouse()
		local useCursor = state.active and state.uiVisible and state.lockMouse
			and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		if not useCursor then
			releaseMouse()
			return
		end
		modal.Visible = true
		if cursor.bound then return end
		cursor.behavior = UserInputService.MouseBehavior
		cursor.iconVisible = UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled
		cursor.bound = true
		RunService:BindToRenderStep(cursorStep, Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 1, function()
			if not (state.active and state.uiVisible and state.lockMouse) or GuiService.MenuIsOpen then
				return
			end
			UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
			UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
		end)
		UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
		UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
	end
	state.uiDestroy = function()
		releaseMouse()
		for _, connection in uiConnections do connection:Disconnect() end
		state.uiSync = nil
		state.uiDestroy = nil
		screen:Destroy()
	end
	local window = create("Frame", screen, {
		Name = "Window", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(376, 472),
		BackgroundColor3 = colour.base, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true,
	})
	round(window, 9)
	create("UIStroke", window, {
		Color = colour.border, Thickness = 1,
		ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
		BorderStrokePosition = Enum.BorderStrokePosition.Inner,
	})
	local scaler = create("UIScale", window, { Scale = 1 })

	local function resize()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local view = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
		scaler.Scale = math.min(1, (view.X - 16) / 376, (view.Y - 24) / 472)
	end
	resize()

	local header = create("Frame", window, {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 9),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(344, 49), Active = true,
	})
	label(header, "YS HUB", 1, 0, 214, 26, 18, colour.text, true)
	label(header, "SNIPER ARENA  /  AIM & FIRE", 1, 27, 275, 14, 10, colour.muted)
	local minimise = create("TextButton", header, {
		Name = "Hide", Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundColor3 = colour.inner, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(302, 3), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 38),
	})
	round(minimise, 6)
	icon(minimise, images.minimise, 10, 10, 18, colour.text)
	create("Frame", window, {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 63), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(352, 1),
		BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = colour.raised,
	})
	create("Frame", window, {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(107, 80), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 342),
		BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = colour.raised,
	})

	local pages = {}
	local tabs = {}
	for index, name in { "Main", "Settings" } do
		local y = 89 + (index - 1) * 48
		local tab = create("TextButton", window, {
			Name = name .. "Tab", Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false,
			BackgroundColor3 = colour.base, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(85, 42),
		})
		round(tab, 5)
		local marker = create("Frame", tab, {
			BackgroundColor3 = colour.accent, BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 11), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 20),
		})
		local glyph = icon(tab, index == 1 and images.main or images.settings,
			9, 12, 17, colour.muted)
		local caption = label(tab, name, 29, 0, 58, 42, 12, colour.muted, true)
		local page = create("Frame", window, {
			Name = name .. "Page", BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(119, 80), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(243, 342),
			Visible = index == 1,
		})
		tabs[index] = { button = tab, marker = marker, glyph = glyph, caption = caption }
		pages[index] = page
	end

	local overlay = create("Frame", window, {
		Name = "DeviceOptions", BackgroundColor3 = colour.inner,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(122, 116),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(238, 160), Visible = false, ZIndex = 30,
	})
	round(overlay, 6)
	create("UIStroke", overlay, {
		Color = colour.border, Thickness = 1,
		BorderStrokePosition = Enum.BorderStrokePosition.Inner,
	})

	local function closeOptions()
		popupOpen = false
		overlay.Visible = false
	end


	local function drawSwitch(control, immediate)
		local enabled = control.preview
		if enabled == nil then
			enabled = control.read()
		end
		local held = activePress and activePress.control == control
		local width = held and 23 or 18
		local x = enabled and 48 - 3 - width or 3
		if control.motion then control.motion:Cancel() end
		if control.trackMotion then control.trackMotion:Cancel() end
		local destination = {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, 4), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 18),

			local position = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
			local function contains(object)
				local p, size = object.AbsolutePosition, object.AbsoluteSize
				return position.X >= p.X and position.X <= p.X + size.X
					and position.Y >= p.Y and position.Y <= p.Y + size.Y
			end

			return

		if capturing then

				keyNotice.TextColor3 = colour.muted

			else

				for _, field in { "menuKey", "aimKey", "triggerKey" } do
					if field ~= capturing and readKey(field).Name == key.Name then
						conflict = true
						break
					end
				end
				if conflict then
					keyNotice.Text = "That key is already assigned."
					keyNotice.TextColor3 = colour.alert
				else

				local control = pressed.control
				local preview = nil

				end

		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

		)
		pointerStart = pointer
	end)

				if math.abs(delta) >= 12 then
					toggle(control, delta > 0)
				else
					local p, size = control.button.AbsolutePosition, control.button.AbsoluteSize
					local x, y = input.Position.X, input.Position.Y
					if x >= p.X and x <= p.X + size.X and y >= p.Y and y <= p.Y + size.Y then
						toggle(control, not control.read())
					else
						control.preview = nil
						drawSwitch(control, false)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if dragging and (input == dragging or (dragging.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)) then dragging = nil end
	end)

	connect(GuiService.MenuOpened, updateMouse)

	local candidate = previous and previous[field]
	if typeof(candidate) ~= "EnumItem" or tostring(candidate.EnumType) ~= "Enum.KeyCode"
		or candidate.Name == "Unknown" or candidate.Name == "End"
		or candidate.Name == "Escape" or taken[candidate.Name] then
		candidate = fallback
	end
	-- F6 was the old default, not an intentional custom binding.
	if field == "aimKey" and candidate.Name == "F6" then candidate = Enum.KeyCode.V end
	if taken[candidate.Name] then
		for _, option in { Enum.KeyCode.RightShift, Enum.KeyCode.V, Enum.KeyCode.T, Enum.KeyCode.B } do
			if not taken[option.Name] then
				candidate = option
				break
			end
		end
	end
	taken[candidate.Name] = true
	return candidate
end

    world = require(RS.Shared.Universe.ECS.world)
    comps = require(RS.Shared.Universe.ECS.components)
    replicator = require(RS.Client.Universe.Replication.clientReplicator)
    Remotes = require(RS.Shared.Universe.Remotes)
    PlayerData = require(RS.Client.Universe.PlayerDataController)
    Event = RS.Shared.Universe.Network.RemoteEvent.Actionable
end)

if not moduleSuccess then
    warn("[Vape V4] Модули Dead Rails не загружены: " .. tostring(moduleErr))
end

--// ====================================================================
--// СОСТОЯНИЕ
--// ====================================================================
local State = {
    AutoBond = false,
    FastFarm = false,
    WholeMap = true,
    MaxScanID = 100000,
    Method = "Vape Motion",
    Notifications = true,
    ShowCounter = true,
    BondCount = 0,
    Transparency = 0.2,
    Theme = "Dark",
}

local collectedBonds = {}

--// ====================================================================
--// ЛОГИКА AUTO BOND
--// ====================================================================
local autoBondThread = nil

local function startAutoBond()
    if autoBondThread then return end

    autoBondThread = task.spawn(function()
        while State.AutoBond do
            local ok, err = pcall(function()
                local char = world:get_resource(comps.ClientStateResource).localCharacter
                if char then
                    if not world:has(char, comps.Sack) then
                        world:add(char, comps.Sack)
                        world:set(char, comps.Sack, { contents = {}, maxContents = 10 })
                    end

                    for id = 1, State.MaxScanID do
                        if world:has(id, comps.Storable) and world:get(id, comps.ObjectId) == "bond" then
                            if not collectedBonds[id] then
                                collectedBonds[id] = true
                                State.BondCount = State.BondCount + 1
                            end

                            local sr = replicator:get_server_entity(id)
                            if sr and sr ~= id then
                                Remotes.Store:FireServer(sr)
                                Remotes.Store:FireServer()
                                Event:FireServer(sr)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            if not ok then
                warn("[Авто Бонд] Ошибка: " .. tostring(err))
            end
            task.wait(State.FastFarm and 0.1 or 0.5)
        end
        autoBondThread = nil
    end)
end

end

-- whatHub v1.5 Full Integrated (Enable All Settings master toggle)
-- Last edited: 2025-09-11

loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DarkNetworks/Infinite-Yield/main/latest.lua'))()

-- Remove any previous whatHub GUIs

    local pg = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    for _, gui in ipairs(pg:GetChildren()) do
        if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and (gui.Name:match("^whatHub") or gui.Name:match("^whatHub_v")) then
            gui:Destroy()
        end
    end
end)

-- Rayfield loader - try a few times
local Rayfield
do
    local attempts, maxAttempts, lastErr = 0, 3, nil
    while attempts < maxAttempts do
        attempts = attempts + 1
        local ok, res = pcall(function()
            return loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()
        end)
        if ok and res then
            Rayfield = res
            break
        else
            lastErr = res
            task.wait(0.6)
        end
    end
    if not Rayfield then
        pcall(function()
            StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
                Title = "whatHub v1.5",
                Text = "Rayfield failed to load, UI will use fallback.",
                Duration = 6
            })
        end)
        Rayfield = {
            CreateWindow = function() 
                return {
                    CreateTab = function() 
                        return {
                            CreateButton = function(_) end,
                            CreateToggle = function(_) end,
                            CreateSlider = function(_) end,
                            CreateSearch = function(_) end,
                            CreateDropdown = function(_) end
                        } 
                    end
                }
            end,
            Notify = function() end
        }
    end
end

-- Safe debug printing
local function dprint(...)
    if _G.whatHubDebug then
        local args = table.pack(...)
        local out = {}
        for i = 1, args.n do out[i] = tostring(args[i]) end
        print("[whatHub DEBUG]", table.concat(out, " "))
    end
end

-- Window
local Window
pcall(function()
    Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
        Name = "whatHub v1.5",
        LoadingTitle = "whatHub Loader",
        LoadingSubtitle = "Made by tennisballs9000",
        ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },

end)
Window = Window or { CreateTab = function() return { CreateButton = function() end, CreateToggle = function() end, CreateSlider = function() end, CreateSearch = function() end } end }

    for _, part in ipairs(Character:GetChildren()) do

    if not Character or not HRP then return false end
    setNoclip(true)
    pcall(function() HRP.CFrame = cf end)
    task.wait(0.12)
    setNoclip(false)

-- streamed-area check
local function isAreaStreamed(position, radius, minParts)
    radius = radius or 25
    minParts = minParts or 6
    local ok, parts = pcall(function() return Workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, radius) end)
    if not ok or not parts then return false end
    local cnt = 0
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then cnt = cnt + 1 end
    end
    return cnt >= minParts
end

-- Light switch toggle (uses ClickDetector interaction)
local lightActive = false
local lightTask = nil

LegitTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Light Switch",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(state)
        lightActive = state

        if lightTask then
            lightTask:Disconnect()
            lightTask = nil
        end

        lightTask = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local lightSwitch = workspace:FindFirstChild("light")
            if not lightSwitch then return end

            local interactive = lightSwitch:FindFirstChild("LightSwitch") and lightSwitch.LightSwitch:FindFirstChild("Interactive")
            local lightsOnBool = lightSwitch:FindFirstChild("LightsOn")
            if not interactive or not lightsOnBool then return end

            local clickDetector = interactive:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
            if not clickDetector then return end

            -- Only act if the state is not as desired
            if (lightActive and not lightsOnBool.Value) or (not lightActive and lightsOnBool.Value) then
                if not HRP then return end
                local originalCFrame = HRP.CFrame

                -- Teleport to switch
                safeTeleportToCFrame(interactive.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,3,0))

                -- Simulate click (call MouseClick on ClickDetector)
                pcall(function()
                    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                        if player == LocalPlayer then
                            clickDetector.MouseClick:Fire(player)
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end)

                -- Wait a short moment for boolvalue to update (or use a small poll to ensure)
                local waited = 0
                while waited < 2 and lightsOnBool and lightsOnBool.Value ~= lightActive do
                    task.wait(0.12)
                    waited = waited + 0.12
                end

                -- teleport back (fail-safe after 2 seconds if not matching desired state)
                safeTeleportToCFrame(originalCFrame)
            end
        end)
    end
})

-- antikillbricks (persistent)

local function removeTouchFromInstance(inst)
    if not inst then return 0 end
    local removed = 0
    for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TouchTransmitter") or child:IsA("TouchInterest") then
            pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
            removed = removed + 1
        end
    end
    return removed
end

local function purgeAllKillTouches()
    local count = 0
    for _, inst in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
            local lname = tostring(inst.Name):lower()
            if lname:find("kill") or inst.Name == "Part" then
                count = count + removeTouchFromInstance(inst)
            end
        end
    end
    return count
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedFirst = game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local GeneralFunctions = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.GeneralFunctions)
local TeamCheck = require(ReplicatedStorage.Modules.TeamCheck)
local Bridge = require(ReplicatedFirst.Client.Utility.Bridge)
local State = require(ReplicatedFirst.Client.Utility.State)
local General = require(ReplicatedFirst.Client.Utility.General)

local OriginalCast = GeneralFunctions.cast
local OriginalGetHitList = GeneralFunctions.gethitlist

local Settings = {
	SilentAimEnabled = true,
	AutoFireEnabled = true,
	InfiniteAmmoEnabled = true,
	AutoFireMeleeEnabled = false,
	FieldOfView = 180,
	IgnoreTeammates = true,
	RequireVisibility = true,
	RequireMouseLocked = true,
	HeadshotRatio = 0.49,
	MaximumDistance = 1500,
	MinimumWeaponRange = 20,
	CameraOriginTolerance = 2,
	ReserveAmmo = 300,
	MaximumAmmoGuard = 999,
}

local previousAssist = getgenv().ArsenalCombatAssist

if previousAssist and previousAssist.Restore then
	previousAssist.Restore()
end

local previousHook = getgenv().ArsenalRaycastHook

if previousHook and previousHook.Restore then
	previousHook.Restore()
end

local function IsAlive()
	return LocalPlayer.NRPBS.Health.Value > 0
end

local function HasWeaponEquipped()
	return State.gun ~= nil and State.equipped ~= "none"
end

local function IsMouseLocked()
	local mouseBehavior = UserInputService.MouseBehavior

	return mouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter or mouseBehavior == Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition
end

local function IsValidTarget(player)
	if player == LocalPlayer then
		return false
	end

	local character = player.Character

	if not character then
		return false
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end

	if not character:FindFirstChild("Hitbox") then
		return false
	end

	if Settings.IgnoreTeammates and TeamCheck.isteam(LocalPlayer, character) then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

local function GetAimPoint(hitbox)
	local verticalOffset = hitbox.Size.Y * Settings.HeadshotRatio

	return hitbox.Position + Vector3.new(0, verticalOffset, 0)
end

local function GetAngleBetween(origin, direction, position)
	local offset = position - origin

	if offset.Magnitude < 0.001 then
		return 0
	end

	local dotProduct = direction.Unit:Dot(offset.Unit)

	return math.acos(math.clamp(dotProduct, -1, 1))
end

local function IsVisibleFromCamera(origin, aimPoint, character, hitList)
	local offset = aimPoint - origin
	local hitInstance = OriginalCast(Ray.new(origin, offset.Unit * offset.Magnitude), hitList)

	if hitInstance == nil then
		return true
	end

	return hitInstance:IsDescendantOf(character)
end

local function FindTarget(origin, direction, hitList)
	local maximumAngle = math.rad(Settings.FieldOfView) * 0.5
	local bestAngle = maximumAngle
	local bestHitbox = nil
	local bestAimPoint = nil

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if IsValidTarget(player) then
			local character = player.Character
			local hitbox = character.Hitbox
			local aimPoint = GetAimPoint(hitbox)
			local distance = (aimPoint - origin).Magnitude

			if distance > 0.001 and distance <= Settings.MaximumDistance then
				local angle = GetAngleBetween(origin, direction, aimPoint)

				if angle < bestAngle then
					if not Settings.RequireVisibility or IsVisibleFromCamera(origin, aimPoint, character, hitList) then
						bestAngle = angle
						bestHitbox = hitbox
						bestAimPoint = aimPoint
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return bestHitbox, bestAimPoint
end

local function IsWeaponRay(ray)
	local originOffset = (ray.Origin - Camera.CFrame.Position).Magnitude

	return originOffset <= Settings.CameraOriginTolerance and ray.Direction.Magnitude >= Settings.MinimumWeaponRange
end

local function HookedCast(ray, hitList)
	if Settings.SilentAimEnabled and IsWeaponRay(ray) then
		local hitbox, aimPoint = FindTarget(ray.Origin, ray.Direction, hitList)

		if hitbox then
			return hitbox, aimPoint, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), hitbox.Material
		end
	end

	return OriginalCast(ray, hitList)
end

local function MaintainAmmo()
	if not Settings.InfiniteAmmoEnabled then
		return
	end

	local gun = State.gun

	if not gun then
		return
	end

	local capacity = math.min(General.getammo(gun), Settings.MaximumAmmoGuard)

	if State.equipped == "primary" then
		if State.primarymode == "2" then
			if State.primarygrenades < 1 then
				State.primarygrenades = 1
				Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
			end

			if State.storedgrenades < Settings.ReserveAmmo then
				State.storedgrenades = Settings.ReserveAmmo
				Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
			end
		else
			if State.ammocount < capacity then
				State.ammocount = capacity
				Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
			end

			if State.primarystored < Settings.ReserveAmmo then
				State.primarystored = Settings.ReserveAmmo
				Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
			end
		end
	elseif State.equipped == "secondary" then
		if State.ammo2count < capacity then
			State.ammo2count = capacity
			Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
		end

		if State.secondarystored < Settings.ReserveAmmo then
			State.secondarystored = Settings.ReserveAmmo
			Bridge.CountAmmo:Fire()
		end
	end
end

local function ShouldAutoFire(hitList)
	if not Settings.AutoFireEnabled then
		return false
	end

	if not IsAlive() or not HasWeaponEquipped() then
		return false
	end

	if Settings.RequireMouseLocked and not IsMouseLocked() then
		return false
	end

	if State.equipped == "melee" and not Settings.AutoFireMeleeEnabled then
		return false
	end

	if State.reloading or State.equipping or State.taunting then
		return false
	end

	local hitbox = FindTarget(Camera.CFrame.Position, Camera.CFrame.LookVector, hitList)

	return hitbox ~= nil
end

GeneralFunctions.cast = newcclosure(HookedCast)

local renderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	MaintainAmmo()

	local hitList = OriginalGetHitList()
